name: gilfoyle-gatekeeper
description: Runs checkpointed-build's final integration check: establishes assembled behavior, required real consumer/native/repository proof, and substantive ordinary independent review. Uses conditional bespoke checks only for declared coverage gaps/requirements. Contract-determined in-slice Class-A repairs route summary(changes_needed) + NEEDS_WORK; contradictions, necessary decisions, out-of-slice work, or non-convergence route summary(terminal) + HALT_FALSIFIED without retry. Leaf stage: no crew; never edits oracles or writes feature code.
